# ThemeToggle

One theme control for every Efolusi site. `ThemeToggle` is a single 44px button that cycles System, Light and Dark. On System it follows the operating system live. The choice is saved in the `efolusi_theme` cookie on `.efolusi.com`, so it carries across every subdomain, with a localStorage mirror.

Put the output of `themeInitScript()` in an inline `<script>` in `<head>`, before the page paints. Without it, a dark-mode visitor sees a light flash. Set `lang="id"` for the Indonesian labels; the label names the current theme and the next one.

```jsx
// app/layout.jsx
<head><script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeInitScript() }} /></head>

// header
<ThemeToggle lang={lang} />
```
